name: Hole Digger in Russia 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Hole Digger in Russia is a humorous digging adventure where everything begins with a missing set of car keys. Armed with only a shovel, you’ll dig deep into Russian soil in search of Grandpa’s prized possession, uncovering layers of valuable resources, underground secrets, and strange surprises along the way.
